article.hook: Someone rewrites the meeting agenda twice before sending it. Mercury in Capricorn drags our thoughts into timelines and bottom lines - no loose ends allowed. The mind starts building, brick by brick, in real time.
article.lived: For the next few weeks, conversations unfold like project plans. We map out steps, weigh consequences, and plot what moves us forward. You notice the exact phrase that shifts a stalled conversation or the quiet patience to listen until a clear goal appears. This isn’t a sprint - it’s a deliberate march through details that usually slip past in the rush.
article.turn: The mind clamps down when it fears inefficiency or chaos, holding back words until they feel perfectly forged. This silence can freeze connection, turning careful thought into cold distance. Waiting for the ‘right’ moment often means losing the moment altogether.
moves: Draft one clear objective before meetings and stick to it.
Name the real obstacle instead of skirting around it.
Schedule one conversation this week where you say exactly what you mean, no edits.
